message.content: Jennifer provides several tips for preventing and alleviating muscle soreness after a workout to LiHua. First, she emphasizes the importance of staying hydrated, suggesting that drinking plenty of water helps with recovery. Secondly, Jennifer recommends engaging in light activities such as gentle yoga or walking, which can help reduce soreness. Additionally, Jennifer advises LiHua to spend time stretching her muscles post-workout, noting that stretching can improve flexibility and relieve tension. Another tip includes using a foam roller on sore spots, which can help with muscle tightness. Lastly, Jennifer stresses the significance of adequate rest, stating that missing recovery days can hinder the healing process of muscles. These strategies are aimed at helping LiHua manage and mitigate the discomfort associated with muscle soreness after intense workouts.
